title: bedding storage bags
text: bedding storage bags. I love love love these storage bags.  I just replaced a MOUNTAIN of plastic storage tubs with just a few of these.  The first pic I have provided has ONE king size quilt (NOT comforter) in it.  PLENTY of extra room for pillow shams.. matching sheets, etc.  The second is of the zipper pulls and you can see the zipper track... cute hearts - they may be cute BUT they are also very functional. That wider heart shape is easy to grab/pinch. when zipping.  They also have very securely sewn nylon web handles. - see pic 3.  The last pic is of a twin size comforter, fluffy blanket, standard size pillow, sham and sheets! Comforters take up more room than quilts but clearly there is still room in even this storage bag.  I have a number of quilts - seasonal prints, etc.. and of course matching shams.  So I put each quilt in their own storage bag and then stacked them in my linen closet.  The outer material is very light in weight.. but a though nylon or nylon like material.  There is a really useful clear window in the front so you can view your bedding or other item(s).  The side handles are so very useful when moving them or stacking them as I did.  Now, having said that, if you put 200lbs in these bags, the handles probably would tear out.. They are not meant for storing super heavy, sharp things. You could easily put 2 or 3 quilts and shams in one bag with no handle problem.  I also store my full height shearling boots in one bag - I have 3 pairs.  It's nice to put them away in a safe, insect free storage bag and have them so easy to retrieve when I want them.  The plastic tubs I was using took up a HUGE amount of space in my linen area and because they are hard plastic, they were unyielding.  These bags easily stack and conform in size and space - making them great space savers - compared to the plastic tubs.  The gray color is a light to medium gray (depending on your opinion)  as you can see in the photos. At this point I have nothing but positive things to report... however,  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I truly hope that this info was helpful to you!
